# Rosebud AI

> > Rosebud AI is an instant-play browser game platform featuring AI-powered game creation and discovery across multiple genres.

Rosebud Play offers a curated collection of browser-based games that require no downloads, enabling players to instantly access RPG, 3D, romance, and other interactive experiences. The platform leverages AI technology to enhance game discovery and creation.
